channel.title: Governance Digest: gnosis
channel.description: New DAO governance proposals and discussions, summarized in plain English.

item.title: GIP-XXX: Withdraw assets from the legacy DAO Safe (gnosis)
item.description: GnosisDAO draft proposes sweeping idle tokens and unclaimed rewards from its old Ethereum governance Safe into the current treasury Safe, about $1.7M by the author's estimate.

item.title: Should GnosisDAO fund an open-source integrity monitor for Gnosis bridges and consensus contracts? (gnosis)
item.description: A builder asks GnosisDAO to fund an open-source monitor that alerts when Gnosis bridge or consensus contracts are upgraded or their admins change. Retroactive pay plus an ongoing amount.
